title: Add user role names and doubt Q&A system

requirements.text: Capture and store user names during the role setup process for both Junior and Senior users after login

quotes: Enter the senior and junior after login with names

acceptanceCriteria: Users must provide their name when setting up their profile after first login
Names are stored in the user profile in the backend
Names are displayed throughout the application when referencing users

requirements.text: Enable Junior users to post doubts with a description and optional attachments
acceptanceCriteria: Junior users can access a doubt posting form
Doubts include a text description field
Optional image attachments can be uploaded with doubts
Posted doubts appear in the main doubts feed

requirements.text: Enable Senior users to answer doubts posted by Junior users
acceptanceCriteria: Senior users can view all posted doubts
Senior users can submit answers with text explanations
Answers can include optional notes and video attachments
Answers are displayed under the corresponding doubt

requirements.text: Display user names in doubt cards, answer cards, and throughout the application UI

quotes: Enter the senior and junior after login with names

acceptanceCriteria: Doubt author names are shown on doubt cards
Answer author names are shown on answer cards
User names appear in the header when logged in
Names are displayed on the leaderboard

constraints: Maintain the existing user profile structure in the backend
Preserve the current authentication flow using Internet Identity
Keep role-based access control for posting doubts and answers
